subject.title: feat(chat-ui): inline diffs for edit and write tool rows

question: For successful `write`/`create` calls without authoritative before-content, should the Apple chat omit exact diffstats or should the gateway/tool-result contract be extended to supply an authoritative diff?
rationale: The current client cannot distinguish a new file from an overwrite using the write payload alone, and the choice determines the durable cross-client result contract.

options.title: Omit ambiguous write stats
options.body: Keep the bounded content preview but render no exact +N/−M statistic unless result details contain an authoritative diff.

options.title: Extend the result contract
options.body: Add an authoritative, bounded write diff or creation marker at the producing layer, then render exact statistics from that result-side data.

recommendation.title: Omit ambiguous write stats
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded content preview but render no exact +N/−M statistic unless result details contain an authoritative diff.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent shared tool-row surface and authored the current follow-up implementation.
